integrity: The proof uses the original primary lemma for support constraints, an analytic angular Lipschitz bound, an exact trigonometric root and an enclosing-interval certificate for eleven finite comparisons. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact containment threshold of one specified unit polygonal arc; no assertion that every unit arc fits any earlier chord trim; global covering threshold remains open. The small numerical improvement is accompanied by a complete uniqueness classification.
title: Exact containment threshold and rigid contact for the canonical unit Z-arc in Wetzel chord trims
